description: Your team's CI/CD pipeline requires a local Docker registry for air-gapped deployments. Set up a local Docker registry (registry:2) running on port 5000. A Python API service application is located at /home/ga/api-service/. Build the application image and push it to your local registry with two tags: 'localhost:5000/api-service:v1.0.0' and 'localhost:5000/api-service:latest'. Then create a docker-compose.yml at /home/ga/api-service/docker-compose.yml that deploys the service using the local registry image (not a build: directive — it must use the registry image tag). Bring up the compose stack and verify the API responds on port 7080. Login: ga / password123
